findings.evidence: grep `valuation_lt_iff|vlt_iff` over ./code/TauCeti returns no hit; the only bridge is `ValuationSpectrum.lean:279 lemma valuation_le_iff ... ↔ v.toValuativeRel.vle x y`. Mathlib has only `ValuativeRel.not_vlt`/`Valuation.Compatible.vle_iff_le`, nothing at `Spv` level.
findings.fix: Add next to `valuation_le_iff`: `@[simp] lemma valuation_lt_iff (v : Spv A) (x y : A) : v.valuation x < v.valuation y ↔ v.toValuativeRel.vlt x y := not_le.symm.trans (valuation_le_iff v y x).not` (or equivalent), and use it at OfIdeal.lean:142-143 and 120-125.
findings.issue: `valuation_le_iff` (`v.valuation x ≤ v.valuation y ↔ vle x y`, `@[simp]`) has no strict companion, so nothing connects `v.toValuativeRel.vlt a 1` — the hypothesis of the new `isContinuous_of_mem_spvOfIdeal_of_forall_vlt_one` and the RHS of `cont_eq_spvOfIdeal_inter_setOf_forall_vlt_one` — to `v.valuation a < 1`. The PR reproduces the conversion by hand at OfIdeal.lean:142-143 (`not_le.mp fun hle ↦ h1 a ha ((valuation_le_iff v 1 _).mp (by simpa using hle))`), and OfIdeal.lean:120-125 does the reverse dance; every downstream consumer holding valuation-level data must redo it.

findings.issue: The file now exposes the same sub-unit conjunct in two spellings: `not_vle_one_of_isContinuous_of_mem_idealOfDefinition` states `¬ v.toValuativeRel.vle 1 (a : A)` while the theorem this PR makes canonical states `v.toValuativeRel.vlt ((a : P.ringOfDefinition) : A) 1`. The assembly at lines 166-167 discharges the `vlt` goal with the `¬ vle` lemma only by unfolding `vlt`, i.e. the post-PR API composes by defeq rather than by statement.

summary: The new statements are phrased in `ValuativeRel.vlt`, but the `Spv` API has only the `@[simp]` `valuation_le_iff` and no `<`/`vlt` bridge, so the file works around it inline; and the sibling conjunct is left in the `¬ vle` spelling, forcing the assembly to bridge the two spellings by defeq.
